1	# ledgerline
2	
3	Ledgerline is the invoicing and billing servce for Acme. It creates invoices,
4	computes tax, posts finalized invoices to the external ledger, and exports
5	monthly reports.
6	
7	## Layout
8	
9	- `src/billing/` - money, invoices, refunds, and tax logic
10	- `src/api/` - the HTTP endpoints
11	- `migrations/` - the SQL schema migrations
12	- `scripts/` - operational scripts
13	
14	## Development
15	
16	Install the dependancies with `pip install -e .[dev]`, then run the tests.
